population.rationale: The conversation generates multiple non-trivial story alternatives, reframes a narrow rebuilding premise into social and emotional dimensions, and compares narrative viewpoints. It fits TRAIN creativity without instantiating the reserved epistemic-control or explicit-constraint evaluation scenarios.

The value is adaptive editorial refinement and critique of an earlier writing approach. The current B01-B18 TRAIN inventory has no clean editorial-revision primary group, so forcing the dialogue into B10 or B16 would distort the intended semantic taxonomy.

The strongest signal is changing only part of an existing edit after user feedback, which is close to the reserved VALIDATION scenario partial_revision. Keep it as diagnostic material rather than weakening that split.
